fee_rule: the fee of a step or of a twin is the fee rate times the larger of its fee mass (the mass a node charges its fee floor on) and the storage mass a node calculates for it, both read from that very transaction, recalculated until the transaction asks for the fee it was built with; a probe pays the fee of its twin; 0 of the steps and twins did not settle within 6 rounds, and for those the larger of the last two candidates was taken
